Customer ticket:
Good morning, I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inquire about a recent issue with my gift card. Unfortunately, I misplaced the physical card shortly after purchasing it. I understand from your terms that replacing a lost physical card incurs a fee of $5.00, which I am happy to pay to resolve the matter. However, I am also concerned about the balance remaining on the card. Since I have not used any of the funds yet, I was hoping to clarify if I could simply receive a refund instead. I recall that unused cards are refundable within 30 days of purchase, and my purchase was only last week. Could you please let me know if I can cancel the replacement request and process a full refund instead? I would prefer to avoid the extra cost if possible. Thank you very much for your time and assistance with this matter. I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Reference standard — key facts a correct reply must convey:
- Unused cards are refundable within 30 days of purchase.
- Replacing a lost physical card costs $5.00.

Handbook sections that cover this answer:
### gift_cards
# Gift Cards

1. **Purchase Limits and Minimums**
   You may purchase a single digital or physical gift card with a minimum value of $25.00 and a maximum value of $500.00 per transaction. If you wish to send a gift card for an amount exceeding $500.00, you must contact our customer support team directly to arrange a custom order. There is no limit to the number of gift cards you can buy in a single day, provided each individual card meets the minimum value requirement. This structure allows you to split larger gifts into multiple smaller cards if you prefer, ensuring flexibility for different recipients.

2. **Delivery Timeframes**
   Digital gift cards are delivered via email within 15 minutes of completing your purchase. Physical gift cards are shipped within 3 business days of order confirmation. Please note that shipping times do not include weekends or public holidays. If you select expedited shipping, the delivery window is reduced to 1 business day. We recommend ordering physical cards at least 5 days before your intended gift date to account for potential carrier delays. Tracking information is provided via email as soon as the item leaves our warehouse.

3. **Expiration and Fees**
   Northwind Outdoor gift cards do not expire. There are no monthly maintenance fees, inactivity fees, or dormancy charges associated with holding a gift card balance. Your funds remain available for use indefinitely. This policy ensures that you can purchase a gift card well in advance of a holiday or special occasion without worrying about the value diminishing over time. We believe in long-term value for our customers, so your balance is preserved exactly as you paid it, minus any applicable sales tax collected at the time of purchase.

4. **Refund Policy**
   Unused gift cards can be refunded to the original payment method within 30 days of the purchase date. Once a gift card has been partially used, the remaining balance cannot be refunded to cash or credit. Instead, the unused portion remains on the card for future use. If a gift card was purchased with a credit card, the refund will be processed to that same credit card. Refunds for gift cards purchased with other payment methods, such as PayPal or debit cards, will be issued as store credit. Please allow 5 to 7 business days for the refund to appear in your account.

5. **Lost or Stolen Cards**
   If you believe your physical gift card has been lost or stolen, contact customer support immediately. We can freeze the card and issue a replacement if you can provide the original purchase receipt and the last four digits of the card number. There is a $5.00 administrative fee for replacing a lost or stolen physical card. Digital gift cards are tied to your email address and can be re-sent to your inbox upon request. We cannot replace a digital card if it has already been redeemed, as the transaction is considered complete.

## Key facts

- Minimum purchase amount is $25.00 per card.
- Digital cards arrive within 15 minutes of purchase.
- Gift cards never expire and have no monthly fees.
- Unused cards are refundable within 30 days of purchase.
- Replacing a lost physical card costs $5.00.

Assistant reply to grade:
Good morning,

I can certainly help clarify your options regarding the lost physical gift card.

Based on the handbook, you have two distinct paths, but they are mutually exclusive depending on whether you want the money back or the card replaced:

1.  **Refund Option:** Since your gift card is unused and was purchased within the last 30 days, it is eligible for a refund to your original payment method [returns]. If you choose this option, you would receive your full purchase amount back (minus any applicable sales tax collected at purchase, as noted in the expiration section [returns]). This would resolve the issue without the $5.00 replacement fee, as you would no longer need the card.
2.  **Replacement Option:** If you prefer to keep the gift card, you can request a replacement by providing your original purchase receipt and the last four digits of the card number. This incurs a $5.00 administrative fee [returns].

**Important Clarification:**
The handbook does not explicitly state that you can "cancel" a replacement request to switch to a refund *after* the replacement process has begun, but it does confirm that unused cards are refundable within 30 days [returns]. Therefore, if you have not yet initiated the replacement process, you should simply request a refund instead of a replacement. If you have already paid the $5.00 fee for a replacement, the handbook does not specify a policy for refunding that specific administrative fee if you change your mind to a cash refund.

To ensure you avoid the extra cost as you prefer, I recommend confirming with a human agent that you wish to **cancel the replacement request** (if already started) and **process a full refund** to your original payment method, as the card is unused and within the 30-day window [returns].

Would you like me to escalate this ticket to a human agent to process the refund and ensure no replacement fees are charged?

schema.description: The reference-aware grader's verdict for one answer trace.

did_not_answer.description: true if the reply does not answer the customer's actual question
did_not_answer.title: Did Not Answer

missing_points.description: key facts from the reference standard that are omitted or stated inaccurately
missing_points.title: Missing Points

note.description: ONE short sentence describing the single most important problem (the open-coding note)
note.title: Note

pass.description: true only if every key fact is stated, every claim is supported, nothing is over-promised and the question is answered
pass.title: Pass

unsupported_claims.description: claims in the reply the handbook sections do not support
unsupported_claims.title: Unsupported Claims

wrong_tone_or_promise.description: true if the reply promises/implies something the handbook does not allow
wrong_tone_or_promise.title: Wrong Tone Or Promise
